PULLALACHERUVU SAI SOWJANYA

SENIOR SERVICENOW DEVELOPER

Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh | 7396855899 | pullalacheruvu.sowjanya@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/pullalacheruvu- saisowjanya

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

ServiceNow Developer with 4+ years of IT experience, including hands-on experience in ServiceNow ITSM administration and development. Experienced across Incident, Change, Problem, Service Catalog, Configuration Management, Knowledge Management, Reporting and Asset Management. Skilled in ServiceNow customization, workflow automation, client- and server-side scripting, REST integrations, migration activities, testing and deployment. Certified ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA) with experience translating stakeholder requirements into practical ServiceNow solutions.

CORE SKILLS

ServiceNow Development

Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs

ITSM

Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request, Service Catalog, Knowledge, Service Portal, SLA

Automation

Workflow Editor, Flow Designer, Scheduled Jobs, Notifications

Data & Migration

Import Sets, Transform Maps, Update Sets, Data Migration, Environment Deployments

Integration

REST Web Services, External System Integration

Reporting & Administration

Reports, Dashboards, Users, Groups, Roles, Forms, Views

Programming

JavaScript, Java, HTML, CSS, SQL

Methodology

ITIL, Agile

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior ServiceNow Developer | MSC Technology Aug 2025 – Present

Develop and configure ServiceNow ITSM solutions, including Record Producers, Service Catalog items, workflows and Flow

Designer automations.

Create Record Producers with customized forms and client-side and server-side validations based on business

requirements.

Design and manage end-to-end catalog request lifecycles covering approvals, fulfillment tasks and notifications.

Create Scheduled Jobs to automate recurring tasks and system processes.

Support migration activities involving data and configuration across ServiceNow environments.

Analyze technical documents and translate requirements into functional requirements and implementation activities.

Gather requirements from stakeholders, support solution design and prepare functional documentation.

Perform testing and deploy Update Sets across Development, Test and Production environments.

ServiceNow Developer / Administrator & Tester | Wipro May 2022 – Jul 2025

Develop and customize ServiceNow ITSM solutions across Incident, Security Incident, Problem, Knowledge, Change and

Service Request processes.

ServiceNow Developer | Sai Sowjanya

• Configure Business Rules, UI Policies, UI Actions, Client Scripts and ACLs, including advanced scripting for platform

customization.

Design and implement ServiceNow workflows, modules, notifications, SLAs, scheduled reports and Service Portal

components.

Create and configure Service Catalog requests and workflow-driven fulfillment processes in collaboration with the

functional team.

Support ServiceNow version upgrades, enhancements, incident resolution and service request management.

Manage users, groups, roles and data imports; use Import Sets and Transform Maps for loading data into ServiceNow.

Move Update Sets between environments and support release/deployment activities.

Create dashboards and reports to provide operational visibility.

Provide production support, configuration troubleshooting and testing to maintain platform stability.

Design and execute manual test cases, test scripts and test plans; perform functional testing, debugging and regression

validation.

Analyze client requirements and contribute to test planning, test scenarios and project documentation.

Support external system integration using REST Web Services.

CERTIFICATIONS

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

ServiceNow Micro-Certification – Flow Designer

ServiceNow Micro-Certification – IntegrationHub

The Complete ServiceNow Developer Course – Udemy

ServiceNow Fundamentals on Demand & Welcome to ServiceNow – Now Learning

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science & Engineering | G. Pullaiah College of Engineering and Technology | 2018 – 2022 | 7.9 CGPA

ServiceNow Developer | Sai Sowjanya
